chapter.verse: Zeisu in biakna innpi pan a paikhiat lai takin a nungzuite in, “Topa aw en in, bangzah lamdang suangte leh bangzah lamdang innte ahi uh hiam?” ci-in a gen uh ciangin,
Zeisu in, “Hih a lian mahmah innte na mu uh hiam? A kiphelkhia loin suang khat tungah suang kiciang khat beek a om kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu in Oliv Mual tungah biakna inn pam ah tu a a om lai takin Piter, Jakob, Johan leh Andru te in,
“Tua thute in cik cianga hong piang ding hiam? A pian’ nading a naih ciangin bang lim hong piang ding ci-in hong hilh in,” ci-in a sim dot uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Kuamah in hong kheem zawh loh nadingin na kikeem un.
Mi tampi in, ‘Kei tua pa ka hi hi,’ ci-in keima min tawh hong pai-in mi tampi a kheem ding uh hi.
Galdona thu leh gal kikapna thu na zak uh ciangin lunghimawh kei un. Tuate a piang ding uh hi. Ahih hangin a beina a tung nai kei ding hi.
Mi namkhat leh namkhat, gamkhat leh gamkhat hong kido ding uh hi. Mun khat khatah ziin hong ling ding hi. Kial zong hong tung ding hi. Tuate in gimna kipat cilna ahi hi.”

“Ahih hangin na kikem un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amaute in upa vaihawmte’ thukhenna sungah note hong pia ding uh hi. Kikhopna inn sungah satna na thuak ding uh hi. Tuate mai-ah teci na pan’ nadingun mangte leh kumpite mai-ah keimah hangin na ding ding uh hi.
Lungdamna Thu a masa belin mipawl khempeuh a kihilh ding hi.

Amaute in zum innah note hong paipih, hong piak uh ciangin bang thu ka gen ding hiam ci-in lunghimawh khol kei un. Tua hun lai taka na ngah uh bangin na gen un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a gen ding no na hi kei uh hi. Kha Siangtho in a gen ding hi.
Unau khat leh khat sih nadingin a kiheek ding uh a, pa in zong a ta a lehheek ding hi. Tate in a nu leh a pate galin a do ding uh a, thah dingin a lehheek ding uh hi.
Keima min hangin mi khempeuh in note hong mudah ding uh hi. A tawp dongin a thuak zote in gupna a ngah ding uh hi.”
“A kisia thei kihhuaina in a kilawm lo munah ding-in a om na muh uh ciangin, (Lai Siangtho a sim theite in thei ta hen) Judah gamah a omte in mual tungah tai ta uh hen.
Inn khum tungah omte in zong ama inn sungah sum khatpeuh la dingin kumsukin lut kei hen.
Lo lai-ah a omte in zong puan la dingin ciahkik kei hen.
Tua lai takin naupai numeite leh naungeek nei numeite in gimna a thuak ding uh hi.
Tua hun in phalbi laitak a, hong tun’ loh nadingin thu na ngen un,
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian’ bawlsa leitung pian’cil a kipan tudongin a piang nawn lo ding gimna lianpi tua lai takin a piang ding hi.
Topa in tua nite a tomsak kei leh, kuamah in suakta zo lo ding hi. Ahih hangin, a teelsate adingin a tomsak ding hi.
Tua lai takin mi khatpeuh in, ‘Hih lai-ah Khazih a om hi; hua lai-ah a om hi.’ hong cih leh, um kei un.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, kamsang zuautheite leh Khazih zuautheite hong piang ding uh a, a teelsate nangawn a kheem zawh leh, a kheem nadingun lim leh nalamdang a lian hong lak ding uh hi. Na kikeem ta un.
Thu khempeuh kong genkhol zo hi.”
“Tua gimna khit ciangin ‘Ni hong mial ding a, kha a hong tang nawn kei ding hi;
Aksite in van pan hong kia ding uh a, vanah a om vangliatnate a kiliing ding uh hi.’
Tua lai takin, vangliatna leh minthan’na tawh Mihing Tapa meii tungah hong kumsuk a mu ding uh hi.
Tua lai takin amah in a vantungmite sawlin, amaute in a teelsa mite lei kiu li pan, lei mong khat pan van mong khat dongin a kikhawmsak ding uh hi.”
“Theikung kiangah thugentehna na sin un. Theikung a hiang meeng a, a teh a no ciangin khuakhal a nai zo ta hi ci-in na thei uh hi.
Tua mah bangin, tuate a piang na muh uh ciangin, amah in kongbiang dongin a hong nai zo hi, ci-in na thei ta un.
Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, hih khang mite a beima-in, hih thu khempeuh hong piang ding hi.
Van leh lei a mangthang ding uh hi; ahi zongin ka thu a mangthang kei ding hi.”
“Tua ni leh tua hun kuamah in thei lo hi. Vantungmite in thei lo uh hi. Mihing Tapa in zong thei lo hi. Pa khat bek in a thei hi.”
“Tua hun cik ciang hong tung ding thei lo na hih uh ciangin, kikem un la, thu ngenin ngak un.
Mi khat in gam dangah pai ning, ci-in a inn nusia-in a nasemte kiangah nasep nading ciat thu a piak khit ciangin, kong khakpa kiangah, ‘Na ngak un,’ ci-in a vaikhak mah bangin, na ngak un.

Tua ahih ciangin na ngak un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, inn teekpa in nitak ahi zongin, zankim laitak ahi zongin, ak khuan’ laitak ahi zongin, zingsang ciang ahi zongin cik cianga hong tung ding, note’n thei lo na hih uh ciangin na ngak un.
Ahih kei leh, thakhatin hong tung leh, note ihmu-in hong mu kha ding hi.
Note kiangah kong cih mah bangin, mi khempeuh kiangah zong, ‘Ngak un,’ ka ci hi,” ci-in Zeisu in a gen hi.
